scope: Actual production full Bern map-only offscreen renderer; no Client, HWND, Level actors, sky, local map lights, UI, sound or physics. Saved camera viewpoints at cue times, dt=0; not animated full-game cutscene replay.
measurement: Offscreen throughput: 8 warmup frames, GPU event drain, CPU wall time over 16 normal render preparations and submissions, final GPU event completion. No Present/vsync. Last measured frame includes draw recording; detailed source traversal, query readback, image and JSON writing are outside timing. N=16 is a short sample subject to OS/GPU clock variation; not Client FPS.
note: PNG annotations were added after all GPU measurements; full scene pixels are preserved below a 140px band. FPS is map-only mean throughput, not Client FPS. Start/end identical geometry and RGBA nevertheless have 32.73% FPS drift; these short timings do not establish setting speed rankings. Geometry is from the exact image frame. Draw is the classified map draw scope; Idx/VS are whole offscreen renderer scope. Unique mesh vertices and VS invocations are different metrics.
